name: topos
description: Use Codex as your Topos: set up a Topos node on this computer, answer questions from your own data, and keep your Codex sessions as a source.

interface.shortDescription: Answer questions from your own data, and keep your Codex sessions as a source.
interface.longDescription: Topos runs on your computer and holds your own data: messages, mail, chat history and, with this plugin, your coding sessions. Say "set up Topos" and the agent installs or finds the node, starts it on this computer with no account, lets you approve the agent once, and turns on your session history. Connect a Dialogues account later if you want sharing, the apps or cloud sources; everything collected moves with it. Then ask questions like "What have I been building this week, and where did I get stuck?". Transcript files never leave the computer; answers go to the AI company behind this tool. The bundled source skill helps create private JSON or CSV sources locally, with an owner approval and no developer key. The bundled fact pack skill turns a request such as "keep track of the books I read" into a checked and tried fact pack, added with one owner approval.
capabilities: Set up a Topos node on this computer
Keep your coding sessions as a Topos source
Create private sources from JSON or CSV
Create fact packs from a plain request
defaultPrompt: What have I been building this week, and where did I get stuck?
